waypoints.name: Rainy Pass / Lake Ann-Maple Pass Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Marblemount or Winthrop, drive SR-20 to the signed Rainy Pass Picnic Area trailhead at milepost 157, on the south side of the highway at Rainy Pass. A Northwest Forest Pass, interagency pass or day-use fee is required to park; overflow parking is along the highway.

waypoints.name: Black Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Take the Lake Ann trail and keep right at the signed junction toward Heather Pass, then follow the unmarked climbers' path across two talus fields to Lewis Lake and up about 1,000 ft more to Wing Lake (~6,900 ft). From the lake, climb snow toward the low notch in the Northeast Ridge, following the moraine wide right before traversing back left, then climb the ridge, about five pitches of loose low-5th terrain, to the summit.
